-- ============================================================
-- test-07-procedures_pos.fh  –  Prozeduren PASS-Tests (PRO-01..02)
-- ============================================================
module Test.Procedures.Pos

import Test.Support exposing Point, make_point

-- PRO-01: Prozedur ohne Parameter
procedure hello()
is
    call Std.IO.logf("Hello from procedure")
end hello

-- PRO-01: Prozedur mit Parameter
procedure log_point(p: Point)
is
    call Std.IO.logf("x=${}, y=${}", p.x, p.y)
end log_point

-- PRO-02: call mit qualifiziertem Namen
procedure run_all()
is
    let p: Point = make_point(10, 20)
    call log_point(p)
    call Std.IO.logf("done")
end run_all

-- PRO-02: call mit mehreren Argumenten
procedure log_two(a: Integer, b: Integer)
is
    call Std.IO.logf("a=${}, b=${}", a, b)
end log_two

end Test.Procedures.Pos
